mobbin:fa27d48b-3a4d-4764-b661-6e6ec0137.summary: From empty Who's on-call, configure rotations, schedule people with Override, see the block on the month calendar, then Pre-fill rotations for two years.
steps: Empty Who's on-call with drag hint
Schedule on-call: one member plus Override
Schedule on-call: two members plus Override
Pre-fill: roster, length Day, start, 2 years
steal: Empty-screen instruction: drag team members into the schedule (screen 1).
Simple create: simultaneous members, start/end, and Override other on-calls (screens 3 to 4).
A people list with colour and drag handles sits beside the month or week calendar (screens 2, 5).
Pre-fill uses an ordered roster, rotation length unit, start datetime, next two years, and Remove all future (screen 6).
avoid: Blind Override other on-calls without showing who is displaced (screens 3 to 4) is unsafe for sim rooms; they need explicit conflict resolution.
mobbin:fa27d48b-3a4d-4764-b661-6e6ec0137.fit: Scheduling: cheapest rotation pre-fill for N sessions from a roster. Map members to learners or faculty, length to session block; keep Override as opt-in conflict policy only.
